stories.headline: Crypto Payments Firm Mesh Eyes $2 Billion Valuation Backed by Binance
stories.body: Binance is reportedly ready to lead a new funding round for crypto payments company Mesh. That’s according to Axios, which says the round could value Mesh at up to $2 billion.
